description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? 
 
 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
 
 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
 
 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
 
The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details. 
 
 
 MUFG Bank N.A. is currently recruiting for an Associate Vice President, Middleware Cloud Services Engineer that will be located in Tampa, FL or Jersey City, NJ who will utilize the software development skillsets in a unique way to deliver stable and strategic automation solutions, enabling software capabilities across MUFG Bank N.A.
 The API First effort will deliver a world-class API Platform for commercial and transaction banking to enable the bank’s competitive market position. This will serve our customers' best interests by providing an improved product suite, increased financial performance, and it will also eliminate significant legacy platforms.
 The Resetting the technology backbone ‘R’ is a multi-year effort that will implement a scalable, secure, compliant, and efficient technology platform; enable the Technology organization to be 'fit for growth' to meet future acquisition, customer growth, and product needs; drive a step-change reduction in technology operating costs; increase speed-to-market; minimize residual risk; and ensure security and compliance.
 
 The Role 
 
 The Middleware Cloud Services Engineer will be a hands-on technical engineer that will be accountable for Software development, R&D and operations in support of the Enterprise Integration Platform at MUFG. On this team, you will face a wide array of technical challenges that greatly impact our business.  This team works closely across the Cloud Transformation Organization, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Engineering and Operations organizations, in order to deliver next generation capabilities in an operationally stable software defined ecosystem to MUFG and its customers. The role will be responsible for design, evolution, implementation and support of the cloud transformation Enterprise Integration Platform operating across geographically diverse data centers, as well as cloud service providers, empowering our customers with capabilities of highly available, automated and cost-effective platform solutions to address resiliency, performance, portability, security and disaster recovery needs.
 The Role will serve as a point of escalation for all operational issues and critical events related to the Enterprise Integration Platform. The position will also need the individual to train the staff, developing standard operating procedures and writing knowledge articles. The Engineer will also be a key contributor to automation roadmap and strategy to improve policy driven automated operations while adhering to the industry best practices and infrastructure-as-code principles.
 
 Intrigued? Then, we would like to meet you if you have the following:
 
 AWS certifications related to architecture, networking, or security are strongly preferred; WSO2 certifications are nice to have
 A minimum of 5 years of experience with large scale mission critical and production scale platforms at an Enterprise or service provider is required
 At least 5 years of strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating AWS API Gateway-based enterprise API platforms; familiarity with WSO2 API Manager is a plus
 Independent judgment, technical problem solving, analytical and decision-making strength is required.
 Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills are required.
 Self-starter with strong teamwork abilities and customer service skills are required.
 Experience working in a Scrum methodology including the Atlassian stack (Jira/Confluence) is preferred.
 
 
 Required Skills: 
 
 
 A minimum of 5 years of experience with large scale mission critical and production scale platforms at an Enterprise or service provider is required
 Deep expertise in AWS API Gateway including REST APIs, HTTP APIs, WebSocket APIs, custom domains, usage plans, stages, throttling, caching, and deployment strategies
 Strong experience designing secure, scalable API architectures on AWS using API Gateway, Lambda, ECS/EKS, ALB/NLB, and private integrations
 Hands-on expertise with API authentication and authorization patterns in AWS including IAM, Cognito, Lambda authorizers, OAuth2, JWT, and mutual TLS
 Experience implementing API lifecycle controls such as throttling, quota management, rate limiting, access policies, WAF integration, and multi-environment promotion on AWS
 Ability to design mock services, execute performance and resiliency testing, and guide internal teams on load testing and capacity planning for AWS-hosted API platforms
 Strong troubleshooting skills across AWS API Gateway, CloudWatch, X-Ray, networking, integrations, and downstream services in production environments
 Provides architecture guidance, best practices, and technology recommendations to ensure a resilient, secure, and cost-effective enterprise API ecosystem on AWS
 Experience with API logging, telemetry, and operational data management using CloudWatch, S3, and related AWS observability services
 Familiarity with data classification, API governance, secrets handling, and secure management of sensitive data across AWS services
 Expertise in multi-account and multi-region AWS deployment models with best practices for resiliency, failover, disaster recovery, and infrastructure standardization
 Ability to automate API platform provisioning and policy enforcement using infrastructure as code tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines
 Experience integrating AWS API solutions with enterprise identity providers and access management platforms such as PingFederate, PingID, and similar SSO technologies
 In-depth knowledge of OAuth2, various grant types, JWT/OAuth tokens, API threat protection, and API security best practices
 In-depth knowledge of distributed tracing and observability, including setup and configuration of tools such as AWS X-Ray, Dynatrace, and CloudWatch for end-to-end API tracing
 Strong experience with AWS integration services such as Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and SNS to build scalable integration patterns and event-driven workflows
 Expertise in translating business requirements into well-governed API products, backend integrations, and transformation patterns across cloud-native services
 Expert in working with container platforms such as OpenShift 4.x, Kubernetes 1.17 or higher, and AWS-native deployment environments
 Familiarity with Splunk and its integrations, including ingestion of AWS platform and API telemetry
 Ability to mentor and train the current team on AWS API Gateway, AWS integration patterns, API security, observability, and related platform engineering practices; basic WSO2 knowledge transfer is a plus
 Experience working with Spring Boot, Java, microservices, Docker, REST, SOAP, Postgres, CI/CD, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, and cloud-native API delivery patterns
 Deep hands-on experience with AWS services including API Gateway, Lambda, EC2, S3, EFS, IAM, VPC, Security Groups, Availability Zones, Route 53, CloudWatch, WAF, and related networking and security constructs
 Nice to have working familiarity with WSO2 API Manager and migration considerations from WSO2-based implementations to AWS-led API platforms
 
 
 Education 
 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of formal education and experience
 
 
 The typical base pay range for this role is between $112K - $137K depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and location. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonus and/or incentive compensation. Additionally, our Total Rewards program provides colleagues with a competitive benefits package (in accordance with the eligibility requirements and respective terms of each) that includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, educational assistance and training programs, income replacement for qualified employees with disabilities, paid maternity and parental bonding leave, and paid vacation, sick days, and holidays. For more information on our Total Rewards package, please click the link below.                        
 
 
 
 MUFG Benefits Summary 
 
 
 
 
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (including (i) the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, (ii) the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, (iii) the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and (iv) the California Fair Chance Act) to the extent that (a) an applicant is not subject to a statutory disqualification pursuant to Section 3(a)(39) of the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934 or Section 8a(2) or 8a(3) of the Commodity Exchange Act, and (b) they do not conflict with the background screening requirements of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) and the National Futures Association (NFA). The major responsibilities listed above are the material job duties of this role for which the Company reasonably believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of conditional offer of employment, if any. 
 
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, gender expression, gender identity, sex, age, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran and military status, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other status of an individual or that individual’s associates or relatives that is protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
